# ML Infrastructure Architecture Dataset

## Overview
This dataset describes a complete machine learning infrastructure architecture as a directed graph of system components (nodes) and data/control flows (edges). It covers the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion through model serving and operational monitoring, including cross-cutting concerns like data lineage and version control.

## Data Source

### ml_architecture
A graph structure with two arrays: `nodes` and `edges`.

**Nodes** (9 total):
- `id` (string): unique identifier for the component
- `label` (string): display name, may include sub-labels for technology stack
- `layer` (string): architectural layer — one of data, compute, serving, observability, cross-cutting
- `sub_components` (array of strings): specific technologies or sub-systems within the node
- `criticality` (integer, 1–10): operational criticality score
- `category` (string): visual grouping category — data-layer, compute-layer, serving-layer, observability-layer

**Edges** (15 total):
- `source` / `target` (string): node IDs
- `flow_type` (string): one of primary, feedback, lineage
- `throughput_gbps` (float): data throughput in gigabits per second, range 0.1–12.5
- `label` (string): short description of what flows along the edge

## Overview

It covers the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion through model serving and operational monitoring, including cross-cutting concerns like data lineage and version control.

- `sub_components` (array of strings): specific technologies or sub-systems within the node
- `criticality` (integer, 1–10): operational criticality score
- `category` (string): visual grouping category — data-layer, compute-layer, serving-layer, observability-layer

- `source` / `target` (string): node IDs
- `flow_type` (string): one of primary, feedback, lineage
- `throughput_gbps` (float): data throughput in gigabits per second, range 0.1–12.5
- `label` (string): short description of what flows along the edge

## Data Notes
- Throughput values are representative estimates for a mid-scale ML platform
- Criticality scores are subjective team assessments
- The graph contains cycles via feedback edges (monitoring → data platform, monitoring → training cluster)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

nodes = [
    {"id": "data_platform",    "label": "Data Platform\n(Spark / Flink)",           "criticality": 9,  "category": "data-layer"},
    {"id": "feature_store",    "label": "Feature Store",                             "criticality": 8,  "category": "data-layer"},
    {"id": "training_cluster", "label": "Training Cluster\n(GPU)",                   "criticality": 10, "category": "compute-layer"},
    {"id": "model_registry",   "label": "Model Registry",                            "criticality": 8,  "category": "compute-layer"},
    {"id": "inference_online", "label": "Inference Service\n(Online / Real-time)",   "criticality": 9,  "category": "serving-layer"},
    {"id": "inference_offline","label": "Inference Service\n(Offline / Batch)",      "criticality": 7,  "category": "serving-layer"},
    {"id": "ab_experiment",    "label": "A/B Experiment\nPlatform",                  "criticality": 8,  "category": "serving-layer"},
    {"id": "monitoring",       "label": "Monitoring &\nAlerting",                    "criticality": 9,  "category": "observability-layer"},
    {"id": "version_control",  "label": "Version Control\n& Data Lineage",           "criticality": 7,  "category": "observability-layer"},
]

edges = [
    {"source": "data_platform",    "target": "feature_store",    "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 12.5, "label": "Raw → Features"},
    {"source": "feature_store",    "target": "training_cluster", "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 8.0,  "label": "Training Data"},
    {"source": "training_cluster", "target": "model_registry",   "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 2.5,  "label": "Trained Models"},
    {"source": "model_registry",   "target": "inference_online", "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 1.8,  "label": "Deploy (Online)"},
    {"source": "model_registry",   "target": "inference_offline","flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 3.2,  "label": "Deploy (Batch)"},
    {"source": "inference_online", "target": "ab_experiment",    "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 5.0,  "label": "Predictions (RT)"},
    {"source": "inference_offline","target": "ab_experiment",    "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 4.0,  "label": "Predictions (Batch)"},
    {"source": "ab_experiment",    "target": "monitoring",       "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 2.0,  "label": "Metrics & Results"},
    {"source": "monitoring",       "target": "data_platform",    "flow_type": "feedback", "throughput_gbps": 0.5,  "label": "Data Quality Alerts"},
    {"source": "monitoring",       "target": "training_cluster", "flow_type": "feedback", "throughput_gbps": 0.3,  "label": "Retrain Trigger"},
    {"source": "version_control",  "target": "feature_store",    "flow_type": "lineage",  "throughput_gbps": 0.1,  "label": "Feature Versioning"},
    {"source": "version_control",  "target": "training_cluster", "flow_type": "lineage",  "throughput_gbps": 0.1,  "label": "Experiment Tracking"},
    {"source": "version_control",  "target": "model_registry",   "flow_type": "lineage",  "throughput_gbps": 0.1,  "label": "Model Lineage"},
    {"source": "data_platform",    "target": "version_control",  "flow_type": "lineage",  "throughput_gbps": 0.2,  "label": "Data Lineage"},
    {"source": "feature_store",    "target": "inference_online", "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 6.0,  "label": "Online Features"},
]

# ── Layout positions (manual placement for clarity) ──────────────────────────
# x: 0..10 left-to-right pipeline flow, y: 0..9 vertical

pos = {
    "data_platform":    (1.0,  7.0),
    "feature_store":    (3.2,  7.0),
    "training_cluster": (5.4,  7.0),
    "model_registry":   (7.6,  7.0),
    "inference_online": (9.5,  8.5),
    "inference_offline":(9.5,  5.5),
    "ab_experiment":    (12.0, 7.0),
    "monitoring":       (14.0, 7.0),
    "version_control":  (4.5,  3.5),
}

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LAYER_COLORS = {
    "data-layer":        "#1E6FBF",   # blue
    "compute-layer":     "#1F8A5E",   # green
    "serving-layer":     "#C76B1A",   # orange
    "observability-layer":"#B02A2A",  # red
}

BG_COLOR   = "#0D1117"
GRID_COLOR = "#1A2232"
TEXT_COLOR = "#E6EDF3"
BAND_COLORS = {
    "data-layer":        "#0A2240",
    "compute-layer":     "#0A2618",
    "serving-layer":     "#2E1800",
    "observability-layer":"#2E0A0A",
}

FLOW_COLORS = {
    "primary":  "#60A0E8",
    "feedback": "#FF6B6B",
    "lineage":  "#A8A0D8",
}

# Node size scaled by criticality (area ∝ criticality)
def node_size(crit):
    return 900 + crit * 200

def edge_lw(gbps):
    """Line-width: 1 → 14 Gbps maps to 1.5 → 10 pt"""
    return 1.5 + (gbps / 14.0) * 8.5

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 13))
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 16.5)
ax.set_ylim(1.5, 10.5)
ax.axis('off')

# ── Background layer bands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layer_band_x = {
    "Data Layer":        (0.0,  4.3),
    "Compute Layer":     (4.3,  8.7),
    "Serving Layer":     (8.7,  13.2),
    "Observability":     (13.2, 15.8),
}
layer_band_colors = ["#0A2240", "#0A2618", "#2E1800", "#2E0A0A"]
for (name, (x0, x1)), col in zip(layer_band_x.items(), layer_band_colors):
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, 1.6), x1 - x0, 8.8,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.0", linewidth=0,
        facecolor=col, alpha=0.35, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text((x0 + x1) / 2, 10.1, name, color="#888EAA",
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5,
            fontfamily='monospace', fontstyle='italic')

# Version-control cross-cutting zone (subtle hatch region)
vc_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.0, 1.8), 9.5, 2.6,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.0", linewidth=1,
    edgecolor="#A8A0D8", facecolor="#1A1530", alpha=0.28, zorder=0
)
ax.add_patch(vc_rect)
ax.text(0.15, 2.0, "Cross-cutting: Version Control & Data Lineage", color="#A8A0D8",
        ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, fontfamily='monospace', fontstyle='italic')

# ── Draw edges ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node_id_to_pos = {n["id"]: pos[n["id"]] for n in nodes}

for edge in edges:
    src = edge["source"]
    tgt = edge["target"]
    ftype = edge["flow_type"]
    gbps  = edge["throughput_gbps"]
    lw    = edge_lw(gbps)
    col   = FLOW_COLORS[ftype]
    is_dashed = ftype in ("lineage", "feedback")

    x0, y0 = node_id_to_pos[src]
    x1, y1 = node_id_to_pos[tgt]

    # Offset slightly for anti-overlap when edges share endpoints
    dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
    dist = max(np.hypot(dx, dy), 0.01)
    perp_x, perp_y = -dy / dist, dx / dist

    # Curvature for feedback/lineage
    if ftype == "feedback":
        # Draw curved arc
        style = "arc3,rad=0.35"
    elif ftype == "lineage":
        style = "arc3,rad=0.25"
    else:
        style = "arc3,rad=0.0"

    alpha = 0.85 if ftype == "primary" else 0.65

    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1),
        connectionstyle=style,
        arrowstyle=f"-|>,head_width={lw*0.4},head_length={lw*0.3}",
        linewidth=lw,
        color=col,
        alpha=alpha,
        linestyle='--' if is_dashed else '-',
        zorder=1,
        shrinkA=24, shrinkB=24,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

    # Edge label (throughput)
    mid_x = (x0 + x1) / 2
    mid_y = (y0 + y1) / 2
    if ftype == "feedback":
        mid_y -= 0.5
    elif ftype == "lineage":
        mid_y -= 0.35

    # Only label primary edges with gbps
    if gbps >= 1.5:
        ax.text(mid_x, mid_y + 0.15, f"{gbps} Gbps",
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.0,
                color=col, alpha=0.8, fontfamily='monospace',
                path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground=BG_COLOR)])

# ── Draw nodes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
id_to_node = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}

for node in nodes:
    nid   = node["id"]
    x, y  = pos[nid]
    cat   = node["category"]
    crit  = node["criticality"]
    col   = LAYER_COLORS[cat]
    label = node["label"]
    sz    = node_size(crit)

    # Glow / halo
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz * 2.2, color=col, alpha=0.12, zorder=2, linewidths=0)
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz * 1.4, color=col, alpha=0.20, zorder=2, linewidths=0)
    # Main circle
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz, color=col, alpha=0.92, zorder=3,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.2)

    # Criticality ring for high-criticality nodes
    if crit >= 9:
        ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz * 1.08, color='white', alpha=0.5, zorder=2.5,
                   linewidths=0, marker='o')

    # Label
    ax.text(x, y - 0.68, label,
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5,
            color=TEXT_COLOR, fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold',
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground=BG_COLOR)],
            zorder=5)

    # Criticality badge
    ax.text(x, y + 0.02, f"★{crit}",
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.0,
            color='white', fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold',
            zorder=6)

# ── Online / Offline branch annotation ───────────────────────────────────────

    {"source": "version_control",  "target": "model_registry",   "flow_type": "lineage",  "throughput_gbps": 0.1,  "label": "Model Lineage"},
    {"source": "data_platform",    "target": "version_control",  "flow_type": "lineage",  "throughput_gbps": 0.2,  "label": "Data Lineage"},
    {"source": "feature_store",    "target": "inference_online", "flow_type": "primary",  "throughput_gbps": 6.0,  "label": "Online Features"},
]

# ── Layout positions (manual placement for clarity) ──────────────────────────
# x: 0..10 left-to-right pipeline flow, y: 0..9 vertical

pos = {
    "data_platform":    (1.0,  7.0),
    "feature_store":    (3.2,  7.0),
    "training_cluster": (5.4,  7.0),
    "model_registry":   (7.6,  7.0),
    "inference_online": (9.5,  8.5),
    "inference_offline":(9.5,  5.5),
    "ab_experiment":    (12.0, 7.0),
    "monitoring":       (14.0, 7.0),
    "version_control":  (4.5,  3.5),
}

# ── Colours ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LAYER_COLORS = {
    "data-layer":        "#1E6FBF",   # blue
    "compute-layer":     "#1F8A5E",   # green
    "serving-layer":     "#C76B1A",   # orange
    "observability-layer":"#B02A2A",  # red
}

BG_COLOR   = "#0D1117"
GRID_COLOR = "#1A2232"
TEXT_COLOR = "#E6EDF3"
BAND_COLORS = {
    "data-layer":        "#0A2240",
    "compute-layer":     "#0A2618",
    "serving-layer":     "#2E1800",
    "observability-layer":"#2E0A0A",
}

FLOW_COLORS = {
    "primary":  "#60A0E8",
    "feedback": "#FF6B6B",
    "lineage":  "#A8A0D8",
}

# Node size scaled by criticality (area ∝ criticality)
def node_size(crit):
    return 900 + crit * 200

def edge_lw(gbps):
    """Line-width: 1 → 14 Gbps maps to 1.5 → 10 pt"""
    return 1.5 + (gbps / 14.0) * 8.5

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 13))
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 16.5)
ax.set_ylim(1.5, 10.5)
ax.axis('off')

# ── Background layer bands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layer_band_x = {
    "Data Layer":        (0.0,  4.3),
    "Compute Layer":     (4.3,  8.7),
    "Serving Layer":     (8.7,  13.2),
    "Observability":     (13.2, 15.8),
}
layer_band_colors = ["#0A2240", "#0A2618", "#2E1800", "#2E0A0A"]
for (name, (x0, x1)), col in zip(layer_band_x.items(), layer_band_colors):
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, 1.6), x1 - x0, 8.8,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.0", linewidth=0,
        facecolor=col, alpha=0.35, zorder=0
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text((x0 + x1) / 2, 10.1, name, color="#888EAA",
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5,
            fontfamily='monospace', fontstyle='italic')

# Version-control cross-cutting zone (subtle hatch region)
vc_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.0, 1.8), 9.5, 2.6,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.0", linewidth=1,
    edgecolor="#A8A0D8", facecolor="#1A1530", alpha=0.28, zorder=0
)
ax.add_patch(vc_rect)
ax.text(0.15, 2.0, "Cross-cutting: Version Control & Data Lineage", color="#A8A0D8",
        ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, fontfamily='monospace', fontstyle='italic')

# ── Draw edges ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node_id_to_pos = {n["id"]: pos[n["id"]] for n in nodes}

for edge in edges:
    src = edge["source"]
    tgt = edge["target"]
    ftype = edge["flow_type"]
    gbps  = edge["throughput_gbps"]
    lw    = edge_lw(gbps)
    col   = FLOW_COLORS[ftype]
    is_dashed = ftype in ("lineage", "feedback")

    x0, y0 = node_id_to_pos[src]
    x1, y1 = node_id_to_pos[tgt]

    # Offset slightly for anti-overlap when edges share endpoints
    dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
    dist = max(np.hypot(dx, dy), 0.01)
    perp_x, perp_y = -dy / dist, dx / dist

    # Curvature for feedback/lineage
    if ftype == "feedback":
        # Draw curved arc
        style = "arc3,rad=0.35"
    elif ftype == "lineage":
        style = "arc3,rad=0.25"
    else:
        style = "arc3,rad=0.0"

    alpha = 0.85 if ftype == "primary" else 0.65

    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1),
        connectionstyle=style,
        arrowstyle=f"-|>,head_width={lw*0.4},head_length={lw*0.3}",
        linewidth=lw,
        color=col,
        alpha=alpha,
        linestyle='--' if is_dashed else '-',
        zorder=1,
        shrinkA=24, shrinkB=24,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

    # Edge label (throughput)
    mid_x = (x0 + x1) / 2
    mid_y = (y0 + y1) / 2
    if ftype == "feedback":
        mid_y -= 0.5
    elif ftype == "lineage":
        mid_y -= 0.35

    # Only label primary edges with gbps
    if gbps >= 1.5:
        ax.text(mid_x, mid_y + 0.15, f"{gbps} Gbps",
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.0,
                color=col, alpha=0.8, fontfamily='monospace',
                path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground=BG_COLOR)])

# ── Draw nodes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
id_to_node = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}

for node in nodes:
    nid   = node["id"]
    x, y  = pos[nid]
    cat   = node["category"]
    crit  = node["criticality"]
    col   = LAYER_COLORS[cat]
    label = node["label"]
    sz    = node_size(crit)

    # Glow / halo
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz * 2.2, color=col, alpha=0.12, zorder=2, linewidths=0)
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz * 1.4, color=col, alpha=0.20, zorder=2, linewidths=0)
    # Main circle
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz, color=col, alpha=0.92, zorder=3,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.2)

    # Criticality ring for high-criticality nodes
    if crit >= 9:
        ax.scatter(x, y, s=sz * 1.08, color='white', alpha=0.5, zorder=2.5,
                   linewidths=0, marker='o')

    # Label
    ax.text(x, y - 0.68, label,
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5,
            color=TEXT_COLOR, fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold',
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground=BG_COLOR)],
            zorder=5)

    # Criticality badge
    ax.text(x, y + 0.02, f"★{crit}",
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.0,
            color='white', fontfamily='monospace', fontweight='bold',
            zorder=6)

# ── Online / Offline branch annotation ───────────────────────────────────────
ax.annotate("", xy=(9.5, 6.5), xytext=(9.5, 7.5),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#FFCC44", lw=1.5, alpha=0.7))
ax.text(10.05, 7.0, "Online /\nOffline\nBranch", ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, color="#FFCC44", fontfamily='monospace',
        path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground=BG_COLOR)])

# Feedback loop annotation arc label
ax.text(7.2, 9.4, "◄  Feedback Loop  ►", ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, color="#FF6B6B", fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.85,
        path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground=BG_COLOR)])

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_x, legend_y = 0.01, 0.01  # axes fraction

# Layer color patches
layer_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#1E6FBF", label="Data Layer"),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#1F8A5E", label="Compute Layer"),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#C76B1A", label="Serving Layer"),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor="#B02A2A", label="Observability Layer"),
]
# Edge style lines
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
edge_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color="#60A0E8", lw=3.0,  label="Primary Data Flow (solid)"),
    Line2D([0], [0], color="#FF6B6B", lw=2.0, ls='--', label="Feedback Loop (dashed)"),
    Line2D([0], [0], color="#A8A0D8", lw=1.5, ls='--', label="Version Control / Lineage (dashed)"),
]
size_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#888',
           markersize=7, label="Node size ∝ criticality (★1–10)"),
    Line2D([0], [0], color="#60A0E8", lw=1.5, label="Edge width ∝ throughput (Gbps)"),
]

leg = ax.legend(
    handles=layer_handles + edge_handles + size_handles,
    loc='lower left', frameon=True,
    facecolor="#0D1822", edgecolor="#2A3850",
    fontsize=7.2, labelcolor=TEXT_COLOR,
    title="Legend", title_fontsize=8,
    ncol=2, columnspacing=1.0,
    handlelength=1.8, borderpad=0.8,
)
leg.get_title().set_color('#AAC0DC')

# ── Title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_title(
    "ML Infrastructure Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline",
    fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR,
    pad=10, fontfamily='monospace',
    path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground=BG_COLOR)]
)
ax.text(0.5, 0.978,
        "Node color = architectural layer  ·  Node size = criticality score  ·  Edge width = data throughput (Gbps)",
        transform=ax.transAxes, ha='center', va='top',
        fontsize=7.5, color="#7A90AA", fontfamily='monospace')

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.tight_layout(pad=0.4)
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=BG_COLOR)
print("Saved to /app/output/result.png")
